definition.en: The merging of criminal law and immigration law, so that immigration control uses criminal-justice tools and criminal records drive immigration outcomes.
definition.zh: 刑法与移民法的融合：移民管控使用刑事司法手段，而刑事记录又决定移民结果。

source.title: Stumpf, J. (2006). The crimmigration crisis: Immigrants, crime, and sovereign power. American University Law Review, 56(2), 367–419.

definition.en: A pattern of behaviour — isolation, monitoring, threats, controlling money or documents — that takes away a partner's freedom. In Queensland it has been a criminal offence (Criminal Code s 334C) since 26 May 2025.
definition.zh: 一种剥夺伴侣自由的行为模式，如孤立、监视、威胁、控制金钱或证件。在昆士兰，自 2025 年 5 月 26 日起这已是刑事罪（《刑法典》第 334C 条）。

note.en: Concept developed by Stark, E. (2007). Coercive Control. Oxford University Press.
note.zh: 概念由 Stark（2007）《Coercive Control》系统提出。
